title: Planetary Surface Gravity
spec: Create a function `gravity(planet)` that calculates the surface gravity of a celestial body in our solar system. Build a comprehensive catalog mapping the names mercury, venus, earth, mars, jupiter, saturn, uranus, neptune, and pluto to their respective average surface gravities in meters per second squared. The function should perform a lookup, case-insensitively, and return the numerical gravity value. If a planet is unknown, return zero. Example input: "mars". Example output: 3.7.

title: Morse Code Translator
spec: Create a function `telegraph(message)` that converts alphanumeric english text into morse code. Define a translation table that maps the letters a through z and the digits zero through nine to their official combinations of dots and dashes. The function should ignore any punctuation or special characters, convert the input string to lowercase, and return a list of morse code strings corresponding to the valid characters. Example input: "sos". Example output: ["...", "---", "..."]

title: Color to RGB Converter
spec: Create a function `rgb(color)` that converts a standard color name to a red green blue integer triplet. The logic requires a registry mapping the common colors red, blue, green, yellow, orange, purple, cyan, magenta, black, white, gray, brown, pink, and teal to their exact integer values from zero to two hundred fifty five. Return a tuple containing the three integers. If the color is not in the registry, return the triplet for black. Example input: "red". Example output: [255, 0, 0].

title: File Extension Categorizer
spec: Create a function `categorize(files)` that groups a list of file names by their broad media types based on their extensions. Build a routing table that maps the extensions txt, md, and pdf to the category document; jpg, png, and gif to image; mp3 and wav to audio; mp4, avi, and mkv to video; zip, tar, and rar to archive; exe and sh to executable. The function should extract the extension from each filename, look up its category, and return a list of corresponding category strings. Unrecognized extensions should be categorized as unknown. Example input: ["report.pdf", "song.mp3"]. Example output: ["document", "audio"].

title: Roman Numeral Generator
spec: Create a function `romanize(number)` that converts a base ten integer between one and three thousand nine hundred ninety nine into a roman numeral string. The algorithm needs an ordered sequence of descending pairs mapping the integer values thousand, nine hundred, five hundred, four hundred, hundred, ninety, fifty, forty, ten, nine, five, four, and one to their respective roman letter representations. Iterate through these pairs, subtracting the value from the total and appending the letters until the number is zero. Example input: 4. Example output: "IV".

title: Minimum Coin Calculator
spec: Create a function `change(amount)` that returns the minimum number of currency denominations needed to make up a specific monetary value. The logic must define a sequence of available denominations in descending order: hundred, fifty, twenty, ten, five, one, quarter, dime, nickel, and penny. Calculate how many of each denomination fit into the target amount, subtract that total, and move to the next smallest denomination. Return a list of integers representing the count for each denomination in the sequence. Example input: 2.30. Example output: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 1, 0, 1, 0].

title: Astrological Sign Determiner
spec: Create a function `zodiac(month, day)` that returns the western astrological sign for a given birth date. Build a calendar directory detailing the twelve signs from aries through pisces, defining their exact start and end months and days. The function should evaluate the provided month and day against these date ranges to find the matching sign. Return the name of the sign as a string. Example input: 5, 15. Example output: "taurus".

title: Musical Scale Generator
spec: Create a function `scale(root, mode)` that generates a sequence of musical notes. The logic requires an ordered catalog of the twelve chromatic notes starting from c up to b. It also requires the interval step patterns for various modes: major, natural minor, harmonic minor, melodic minor, dorian, phrygian, lydian, and mixolydian. Each mode pattern consists of seven integer steps. Starting from the root note index, apply the mode's interval pattern to select the subsequent notes, wrapping around the chromatic sequence as needed. Return a list of the note strings. Example input: "c", "major". Example output: ["c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "a", "b"].

title: Nutritional Calorie Counter
spec: Create a function `calories(recipe)` that calculates the total energy content for a list of ingredient strings. Define a food database mapping the ingredients apple, banana, chicken, rice, broccoli, butter, egg, milk, bread, cheese, beef, potato, onion, and garlic to their respective macronutrient profiles per hundred grams: protein, carbohydrates, and fat. Calculate total calories by summing the macros of each recipe ingredient and multiplying by four for protein, four for carbohydrates, and nine for fat. Return the total as a float. Example input: ["egg", "bread", "butter"]. Example output: 350.5.

title: Progressive Tax Calculator
spec: Create a function `tax(income)` that calculates the income tax owed based on progressive tax brackets. The system requires a comprehensive schedule of income thresholds and their marginal rates. The thresholds are at zero, ten thousand, thirty thousand, sixty thousand, hundred thousand, two hundred thousand, five hundred thousand, and one million. The rates scale from ten percent up to thirty seven percent. Traverse the brackets, applying the appropriate percentage to the portion of income that falls within each tier. Return the total tax owed as a float. Example input: 45000. Example output: 6500.0.

title: Chess Piece Movement
spec: Create a function `moves(piece, position)` that returns a list of valid destination squares for a chess piece making a single move from a starting position on an empty board. Define the movement rules by mapping the pieces king, queen, rook, bishop, and knight to their allowed horizontal and vertical directional vectors. For example, a knight has eight specific jumping vectors, while a rook has four orthogonal vectors. The function should generate all valid coordinates on an eight by eight grid based on these vectors and the starting square. Return a list of standard board coordinates. Example input: "knight", "d4". Example output: ["b3", "b5", "c2", "c6", "e2", "e6", "f3", "f5"].

title: Scrabble Word Scorer
spec: Create a function `score(word)` that calculates the point value of a given string in the game of scrabble. The logic relies on a comprehensive scoring table mapping every letter of the alphabet to its point value. The values are one point for common vowels and consonants like a and t, up to ten points for rare letters like q and z. The function should convert the input to lowercase, ignore invalid characters, and sum the point values for each valid letter. Return the total integer score. Example input: "quiz". Example output: 22.

title: NATO Phonetic Alphabet
spec: Create a function `spell(word)` that converts a string into its nato phonetic alphabet representation. Build a full translation dictionary mapping the letters a through z to the official standard words starting with alpha, bravo, charlie, and so on up to zulu. The function should iterate through the characters of the input string, ignoring spaces and punctuation, and look up each letter. Return a list of the corresponding phonetic words. Example input: "cat". Example output: ["charlie", "alpha", "tango"].

title: Airline Baggage Fees
spec: Create a function `fee(bags, tier)` that calculates the total cost for checking luggage on an airline. Define a pricing ruleset based on the passenger tier (basic, economy, business, first) and the sequence number of the bag. The ruleset must dictate the base price for the first, second, third, and fourth bags, along with specific weight and size limits per tier. It must also list the flat penalties for overweight bags and oversized bags. Iterate over the provided list of bags, applying base fees and any necessary penalties based on the tier rules. Return the total integer cost. Example input: [25, 30], "economy". Example output: 150.

title: Poker Hand Evaluator
spec: Create a function `hand(cards)` that determines the strength of a five card poker hand. The logic requires a full ranking hierarchy mapping the classifications high card, one pair, two pair, three of a kind, straight, flush, full house, four of a kind, straight flush, and royal flush to numerical strength values from one to ten. Parse the input list of card strings to count the frequencies of ranks (from two to ace) and suits (hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades) to identify the highest matching classification. Return the integer strength of the hand. Example input: ["ace hearts", "king hearts", "queen hearts", "jack hearts", "ten hearts"]. Example output: 10.

title: HTTP Status Code Describer
spec: Create a function `status(code)` that maps an integer http response code to its official human readable text message. Build an extensive registry that covers all common standard codes, including two hundred, two hundred one, four hundred, four hundred one, four hundred three, four hundred four, five hundred, five hundred two, five hundred three, and five hundred four, pairing each with its short description sentence. If the provided integer matches a code in the registry, return the descriptive string. If not, return a generic unknown error message. Example input: 404. Example output: "not found".

title: Card Deck Dealer
spec: Create a function `deal(players)` that generates, shuffles, and distributes a standard deck of fifty two playing cards. Define the deck by combining an ordered sequence of suits (hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades) with an ordered sequence of ranks (two through ten, jack, queen, king, ace). Build the full deck of card strings, shuffle them using a deterministic algorithm with a fixed seed for predictability, and distribute them evenly among the specified number of players in a round robin fashion. Return a list of lists containing the card strings for each player. Example input: 2. Example output: [["two hearts", ...], ["five clubs", ...]].

title: Braille Pattern Translator
spec: Create a function `braille(text)` that converts standard english text into braille dot patterns. The system needs a full character map that links the lowercase letters a through z to their respective six dot cell configurations, representing each cell as a six character string of ones and zeros indicating raised and flat dots. Iterate through the input text, converting each known character into its binary string representation and ignoring unknown symbols. Return a list of the binary strings. Example input: "ab". Example output: ["100000", "110000"].

title: Global Timezone Converter
spec: Create a function `local(hour, city)` that converts a given twenty four hour utc time into the local time of a specified major city. The logic requires a comprehensive offset database mapping the cities new york, los angeles, london, paris, tokyo, sydney, dubai, moscow, beijing, and mumbai to their standard hourly offsets from utc. Apply the appropriate offset to the input hour and wrap the result so it falls strictly between zero and twenty three. Return the calculated integer hour. Example input: 12, "tokyo". Example output: 21.

title: Periodic Table Lookup
spec: Create a function `element(name)` that returns key scientific properties of a chemical element. Build a reference catalog detailing the common elements hydrogen, helium, lithium, beryllium, boron, carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, fluorine, neon, sodium, and magnesium. For each element name, store a pairing of its integer atomic number and its standard one or two letter chemical symbol. Perform a lookup using the provided string and return the tuple containing the number and symbol. Example input: "oxygen". Example output: [8, "O"].

title: Shopping Cart Discounts
spec: Create a function `checkout(total, codes)` that applies an array of promotional codes to a shopping cart total. The logic must define an active promotions registry mapping various coupon strings like welcome, staff, wholesale, clearance, holiday, birthday, and loyalty to their specific reduction rules, which may be percentage discounts or flat dollar amount subtractions. Apply the codes sequentially to the total, ensuring the final amount never drops below zero. Return the final discounted total as a float. Example input: 100.0, ["welcome", "birthday"]. Example output: 80.0.

title: Vending Machine Simulator
spec: Create a function `vend(item, payment)` that simulates a transaction at a vending machine. Define the internal machine state using an inventory catalog that tracks ten distinct snack names (like water, cola, diet cola, iced tea, orange juice, chips, pretzels, candy bar, gum, and mints), mapping each to its price and its currently available stock quantity. The function should check if the requested item exists, if it is in stock, and if the payment is sufficient. If successful, deduct the stock and return a tuple with a success message and the exact change amount. Example input: "chips", 2.0. Example output: ["success", 0.5].

title: Manual Hexadecimal Converter
spec: Create a function `hexadecimal(number)` that manually converts a positive base ten integer into a base sixteen string without using built in formatters. The algorithm requires a specific translation table mapping the decimal values zero through fifteen to their hexadecimal character equivalents, covering the digits zero to nine and the letters a through f. Repeatedly divide the input number by sixteen, map the remainder using the translation table, and prepend it to the result string until the quotient is zero. Return the final string. Example input: 255. Example output: "ff".

title: Continental Geography
spec: Create a function `continent(country)` that identifies the continental region for a given country name. The system relies on a geographical database that maps a large set of country names to their respective continents. Include entries for canada, usa, mexico mapping to north america; brazil, argentina, peru to south america; uk, france, germany, italy to europe; china, japan, india, thailand to asia; and egypt, nigeria, south africa, kenya to africa. Search the database for the input string and return the continent name. Example input: "japan". Example output: "asia".

title: Weather Alert Broadcaster
spec: Create a function `alert(condition)` that provides the official public warning text for severe weather events. Build an emergency broadcasting registry that maps specific event codes like tornado, hurricane, blizzard, flood, thunderstorm, heatwave, freeze, fog, hail, and wind to their standardized, multi word alert sentences designed for public safety announcements. Look up the provided condition code and return the exact corresponding warning string. If the condition is safe or unknown, return a clear skies message. Example input: "tornado". Example output: "take cover immediately in a windowless room".

title: Coffee Shop Order Calculator
spec: Write a function `bill(order)` that calculates the total price, calories, and preparation time of an order. The shop data includes espresso at two dollars, five calories, one minute, beverage category, and vegan. Latte is four dollars, one hundred twenty calories, two minutes, beverage, and non vegan. Mocha is four dollars and fifty cents, two hundred calories, three minutes, beverage, and non vegan. Cold brew is three dollars, ten calories, one minute, beverage, and vegan. Vanilla syrup is fifty cents, forty calories, zero minutes, additive, and vegan. Caramel is fifty cents, fifty calories, zero minutes, additive, and non vegan. Oat milk is seventy five cents, thirty calories, zero minutes, additive, and vegan. Whole milk is zero dollars, sixty calories, zero minutes, additive, and non vegan. The input is a list of ordered item names. Return a tuple of total cost, total calories, and maximum preparation time among all items. For example, an input of ["espresso", "vanilla syrup", "oat milk"] should return (3.25, 75, 1).

title: Transit Fare Calculator
spec: Write a function `fare(trips)` that calculates the total cost and distance of a journey. The transit map includes center zone at two dollars, five kilometers, downtown region, bus mode, and accessible. North zone is three dollars, twelve kilometers, suburban region, train mode, and not accessible. South zone is three dollars, ten kilometers, suburban region, train mode, and accessible. East zone is four dollars, fifteen kilometers, rural region, train mode, and not accessible. West zone is four dollars, fourteen kilometers, rural region, bus mode, and accessible. Stadium zone is five dollars, six kilometers, downtown region, tram mode, and accessible. The input is a list of zone names. Return a tuple of total cost and total distance. For example, an input of ["center zone", "airport zone"] should return (10.0, 25).

title: Animal Taxonomy Classifier
spec: Write a function `classify(animals)` that aggregates the habitats and identifies if any endangered species are present. The database includes lion as mammal, carnivore, fifteen years, savanna, and vulnerable. Eagle is bird, carnivore, twenty years, mountains, and least concern. Frog is amphibian, insectivore, five years, wetlands, and endangered. Shark is fish, carnivore, thirty years, ocean, and vulnerable. Turtle is reptile, omnivore, fifty years, coastal, and endangered. Elephant is mammal, herbivore, sixty years, savanna, and endangered. Ostrich is bird, omnivore, forty years, desert, and least concern. Salamander is amphibian, carnivore, ten years, forest, and near threatened. The input is a list of animal names. Return a tuple containing a list of unique habitats and a boolean indicating if any endangered animals are included. For example, an input of ["lion", "eagle"] should return (["savanna", "mountains"], False).

title: Constellation Locator
spec: Write a function `locate(stars)` that finds the total area and collects the primary stars of observed constellations. The atlas defines orion in the celestial equator, rigel star, five hundred ninety four degrees, january, and greek myth. Ursa major is north, dubhe star, twelve hundred eighty degrees, april, and greek myth. Crux is south, acrux star, sixty eight degrees, may, and modern. Cassiopeia is north, schedar star, five hundred ninety eight degrees, november, and greek myth. Scorpius is south, antares star, four hundred ninety seven degrees, july, and greek myth. Cygnus is north, deneb star, eight hundred four degrees, september, and greek myth. Centaurus is south, alpha centauri star, ten hundred sixty degrees, may, and greek myth. Canis major is south, sirius star, three hundred eighty degrees, february, and greek myth. The input is a list of constellation names. Return a tuple with total area and a list of primary stars. For example, an input of ["orion", "crux"] should return (662, ["rigel", "acrux"]).

title: Waste Sorting Guide
spec: Write a function `sort(items)` that calculates the total processing time and carbon footprint for a batch of waste. The facility handles banana peels in compost, ten days, zero footprint, organic, and no rinse. Glass bottles go to recycling, thirty days, low footprint, glass, and needs rinse. Plastic wrappers go to landfill, five hundred days, high footprint, plastic, and no rinse. Cardboard boxes go to recycling, twenty days, low footprint, paper, and no rinse. Batteries go to hazardous, zero days, high footprint, chemical, and no rinse. Coffee grounds go to compost, fourteen days, zero footprint, organic, and no rinse. Styrofoam goes to landfill, a thousand days, high footprint, plastic, and no rinse. Paint cans go to hazardous, zero days, high footprint, metal, and needs rinse. The input is a list of item names. Return a tuple of total days and a list of unique footprints. For example, an input of ["banana peels", "glass bottles"] should return (40, ["zero footprint", "low footprint"]).

title: Language Family Categorizer
spec: Write a function `categorize(languages)` that calculates the total speakers and unique writing systems for a group of languages. The data includes spanish in indo european, romance, four hundred sixty, latin script, and subject verb object. Hindi is indo european, indo aryan, three hundred forty, devanagari script, and subject object verb. Mandarin is sino tibetan, sinitic, nine hundred twenty, hanzi script, and subject verb object. Hungarian is uralic, ugric, thirteen, latin script, and subject verb object. The input is a list of language names. Return a tuple of total millions of speakers and a list of unique scripts. For example, an input of ["spanish", "arabic"] should return (770, ["latin script", "arabic script"]).

title: Gemstone Database Lookup
spec: Write a function `identify(gems)` that gathers the unique crystal systems and checks for maximum hardness among a collection of stones. The catalog contains ruby which is red, nine hardness, transparent, trigonal, and july. Sapphire is blue, nine hardness, transparent, trigonal, and september. Emerald is green, eight hardness, transparent, hexagonal, and may. Diamond is clear, ten hardness, transparent, cubic, and april. Amethyst is purple, seven hardness, translucent, trigonal, and february. Topaz is yellow, eight hardness, transparent, orthorhombic, and november. Opal is iridescent, six hardness, opaque, amorphous, and october. Quartz is pink, seven hardness, translucent, trigonal, and january. The input is a list of gemstone names. Return a tuple of a list of unique crystal systems and the highest hardness integer. For example, an input of ["ruby", "diamond"] should return (["trigonal", "cubic"], 10).

title: Guitar Chord Mapper
spec: Write a function `fret(chords)` that computes the total fingers required and lists the unique difficulty levels for a song progression. The guide includes c major with c root, a string, fret three, beginner, and three fingers. G major with g root, low e string, fret three, beginner, and three fingers. F major with f root, low e string, fret one, intermediate, and four fingers. B minor with b root, a string, fret two, intermediate, and four fingers. D minor with d root, d string, fret zero, beginner, and three fingers. E minor with e root, low e string, fret zero, beginner, and two fingers. A major with a root, a string, fret zero, beginner, and three fingers. C sharp minor with c sharp root, a string, fret four, advanced, and four fingers. The input is a list of chord names. Return a tuple of total fingers and a list of unique difficulties. For example, an input of ["c major", "f major"] should return (7, ["beginner", "intermediate"]).

title: Tea Brewing Assistant
spec: Write a function `brew(teas)` that calculates the total steeping time and collects the unique origins for a tea tasting. The instructions cover green tea at eighty degrees, three minutes, low caffeine, china, and unoxidized. Black tea is one hundred degrees, five minutes, high caffeine, india, and fully oxidized. Rooibos is one hundred degrees, six minutes, no caffeine, south africa, and fully oxidized. Pu erh is ninety five degrees, five minutes, high caffeine, china, and fermented. The input is a list of tea types. Return a tuple of total time and unique origins. For example, an input of ["green tea", "rooibos"] should return (9, ["china", "south africa"]).

title: Mythological Creature Origin
spec: Write a function `trace(creatures)` that collects the unique elements and counts the number of evil aligned creatures in a story. The compendium lists minotaur from greek, strength trait, earth element, evil alignment, and humanoid beast. Kitsune is japanese, illusion trait, fire element, neutral alignment, and fox. Kraken is norse, size trait, water element, evil alignment, and squid. Sphinx is egyptian, riddles trait, earth element, neutral alignment, and lion human. Wendigo is algonquian, hunger trait, ice element, evil alignment, and gaunt humanoid. Qilin is chinese, luck trait, earth element, good alignment, and hooved beast. Banshee is celtic, wailing trait, air element, evil alignment, and spirit. Quetzalcoatl is aztec, creation trait, wind element, good alignment, and feathered serpent. The input is a list of creature names. Return a tuple of unique elements and the integer count of evil creatures. For example, an input of ["kraken", "qilin"] should return (["water", "earth"], 1).

title: Recipe Substitute Finder
spec: Write a function `substitute(ingredients)` that computes the total required substitute volume and collects allergen warnings. The pantry maps butter to applesauce at ratio one, sweet flavor, no allergens, and solid. Egg maps to mashed banana at ratio one, sweet flavor, no allergens, and solid. Peanut butter maps to sunflower butter at ratio one, nutty flavor, seed allergen, and paste. Wheat flour maps to almond flour at ratio one, nutty flavor, nut allergen, and powder. For example, an input of [("butter", 2), ("wheat flour", 3)] should return (5.0, ["no allergens", "nut allergen"]).

title: Cloud Server Pricing
spec: Write a function `estimate(servers)` that calculates the total hourly cost and collects the network speeds for a cluster deployment. The provider offers micro for ten cents, one core, one gigabyte, ebs storage, and low network. Small is twenty cents, two cores, four gigabytes, ebs storage, and moderate network. Medium is forty cents, four cores, eight gigabytes, nvme storage, and high network. Large is eighty cents, eight cores, sixteen gigabytes, nvme storage, and high network. The input is a list of instance types. Return a tuple of total cost and unique network speeds. For example, an input of ["micro", "large"] should return (0.90, ["low network", "high network"]).

title: Ski Trail Guide
spec: Write a function `navigate(trails)` that calculates the total length and lists the unique lift access points for a skiing itinerary. The mountain features snowflake as beginner, two kilometers, one hundred meters, groomed, and chair one. Pinecone is beginner, three kilometers, one fifty meters, groomed, and chair two. Grizzly is intermediate, five kilometers, three hundred meters, groomed, and gondola. Avalanche is expert, four kilometers, four hundred meters, ungroomed, and tram. title: Historical Era Timeline

title: Laundry Symbol Decoder

title: Fragrance Note Profiler
spec: Write a function `profile(perfumes)` that calculates the average longevity and collects the seasonal recommendations for a perfume set. title: Bicycle Gear Calculator
spec: Write a function `gear(combinations)` that computes the total front teeth and collects the terrain types for a cyclist's garage. The chart defines climbing with thirty front, thirty rear, low advantage, mountain terrain, and long chain. Cruising with forty front, twenty rear, medium advantage, city terrain, and standard chain. spec: An observatory categorizes planets based on their atmospheric compositions and core types. title: Fantasy Character Equipment

title: Mountain Bike Maintenance
spec: A bike shop tracks maintenance tasks for various bicycle components. spec: A photography application sorts lenses into distinct use cases, where wide angle lenses are suited for landscapes, real estate, architecture, and astrophotography. title: Car Dashboard Indicators
spec: A vehicle diagnostic tool interprets dashboard warning lights using predefined categories. title: Landfill Diversion Categories
spec: A waste management facility directs materials to specific processing lines. title: Aquarium Water Parameters
spec: An aquarium planner gathers environmental needs for different aquatic setups. Store lists of characteristics where tropical setups need warm water, low salinity, fine sand, and broadleaf plants, marine setups require moderate temperatures, high salinity, crushed coral, and live rock, brackish setups need fluctuating salinity, moderate temperatures, sandy substrate, and mangrove roots, and coldwater setups prefer low temperatures, zero salinity, large gravel, and hardy plants. Return a tuple containing the summary list and the master list of all characteristics. Example: passing marine setups returns a tuple with a list containing marine setups, and a list of its four characteristics.

title: Board Game Expansions

title: Garden Vegetable Planting
