Define a mapping for stretch types where no stretch uses a straight stitch, two way stretch uses a narrow zigzag, and four way stretch uses an overlock stitch. Define a mapping for thread types where cotton provides low durability, polyester provides high durability, and silk provides a glossy finish. Define a list of delicate materials containing chiffon, organza, and lace. Determine the machine settings for a batch of sewing projects. Example input: heavy fabric with no stretch and cotton thread. Expected output: four millimeter length, denim needle, straight stitch, and low durability.

title: Meat Roasting Guide
spec: The entry function is `roast(meats)`. Define a mapping for beef doneness where rare targets one hundred twenty degrees and a red center, medium targets one hundred forty degrees and a pink center, and well targets one hundred sixty degrees and a brown center. Define a mapping for poultry types where whole chicken targets one hundred sixty five degrees with a twenty minute rest, turkey breast targets one hundred seventy degrees with a thirty minute rest, and duck targets one hundred thirty five degrees with a ten minute rest. Define a mapping for pork cuts where loin requires dry heat, shoulder requires slow braising, and belly requires high heat roasting. Define a list of resting aromatics containing rosemary, thyme, and garlic. Process a list of meat orders to return the target temperature, center color or rest time, and cooking method. Example input: a medium beef order. Expected output: one hundred forty degrees and a pink center.

title: Welding Gas Formulator
spec: The entry function is `formulate(metals)`. Define a mapping for primary metals where mild steel requires a seventy five percent argon mix and provides deep penetration, stainless steel requires a ninety percent helium mix and provides medium penetration, and aluminum requires pure argon and provides shallow penetration. Define a mapping for arc transfer modes where short circuit operates at low voltage, globular operates at medium voltage, and spray operates at high voltage. Define a mapping for electrode types where solid wire creates minimal slag, flux core creates heavy slag, and metal core creates light slag. Define a list of toxic fumes to ventilate containing zinc oxide, ozone, and hexavalent chromium. Recommend the gas mix, voltage level, and slag expectation for welding tasks. Example input: mild steel with a short circuit arc and solid wire. Expected output: seventy five percent argon mix, deep penetration, low voltage, and minimal slag.

title: Helicopter Rotor Evaluator
spec: The entry function is `evaluate(rotors)`. Define a mapping for configurations where a single rotor provides high agility and requires a tail rotor, a tandem rotor provides heavy lift and requires complex gearing, and a coaxial rotor provides compact size and requires rigid blades. Define a mapping for blade counts where two blades offer low drag, three blades offer moderate drag, and four blades offer high stability. Define a mapping for blade materials where composite is lightweight and expensive, aluminum is standard and affordable, and wood is outdated and heavy. Define a list of extreme maneuvers containing autorotation, loop, and barrel roll. Assess a list of helicopter designs by combining these structural properties. Example input: a tandem rotor with four composite blades. Expected output: heavy lift, complex gearing, high stability, lightweight, and expensive.

title: Optical Fiber Router
spec: The entry function is `route(connections)`. Define a mapping for core types where single mode has a nine micron core and allows long distance, multi mode step has a fifty micron core and allows short distance, and multi mode graded has a sixty two micron core and allows medium distance. Define a mapping for light sources where light emitting diodes operate at low speeds, vertical cavity lasers operate at high speeds, and fabry perot lasers operate at ultra high speeds. Define a mapping for jacket colors where yellow indicates single mode, orange indicates multi mode, and aqua indicates laser optimized. Define a list of high loss connectors containing straight tip, lucency, and subscriber. Calculate the cable specifications for a network layout. Example input: single mode with a vertical cavity laser and a yellow jacket. Expected output: nine micron core, long distance, high speeds, and single mode indication.

title: Paper Airplane Grader
spec: The entry function is `grade(designs)`. Define a mapping for wing shapes where a delta wing yields high speed and low glide, a straight wing yields low speed and high glide, and a swept wing yields moderate speed and moderate glide. Define a mapping for nose folds where a pointed nose reduces drag and increases damage risk, a blunt nose increases drag and reduces damage risk, and a heavy nose shifts the center of gravity forward. Define a mapping for tail modifications where winglets improve stability, elevators control pitch, and rudders control yaw. Define a list of advanced folding techniques containing the water bomb base, the squash fold, and the petal fold. Score the flight characteristics of various folded designs. Example input: a straight wing with a blunt nose and winglets. Expected output: low speed, high glide, increased drag, reduced damage risk, and improved stability.

title: Submarine Dive Planner
spec: The entry function is `plan(profiles)`. Define a mapping for hull classes where attack submarines prioritize speed and torpedo capacity, ballistic submarines prioritize stealth and missile capacity, and research submarines prioritize visibility and manipulator arms. Define a mapping for depth zones where periscope depth allows communication, shallow depth avoids commercial shipping, test depth stresses the hull, and crush depth causes structural failure. Define a mapping for propulsion types where nuclear offers unlimited endurance, diesel electric requires snorkeling, and air independent offers quiet operation. Define a list of emergency ascent procedures containing main ballast blow, emergency propulsion, and drop weights. Create dive summaries for naval operations. Example input: an attack submarine at periscope depth with nuclear propulsion. Expected output: prioritizes speed, allows communication, and offers unlimited endurance.

title: Keyboard Switch Matcher
spec: The entry function is `match(preferences)`. Define a mapping for switch behaviors where linear switches are smooth and quiet, tactile switches have a bump and moderate noise, and clicky switches have a bump and loud noise. Define a mapping for spring weights where light requires forty grams of force, medium requires fifty grams of force, and heavy requires sixty five grams of force. Define a mapping for housing materials where polycarbonate produces a high pitch, nylon produces a deep pitch, and polyoxymethylene produces a muted pitch. Define a list of lubrication points containing the stem rails, the spring ends, and the stabilizing wire. Recommend the sound profile and typing feel based on user inputs. Example input: a linear switch with a heavy spring and nylon housing. Expected output: smooth and quiet, sixty five grams of force, and a deep pitch.

title: Bicycle Frame Analyzer
spec: The entry function is `analyze(frames)`. Define a mapping for frame materials where steel is durable and heavy, aluminum is stiff and light, carbon fiber is vibration damping and ultra light, and titanium is corrosion resistant and expensive. Define a mapping for tube shapes where round tubes offer classic aesthetics, aero tubes reduce wind drag, and oversized tubes increase bottom bracket stiffness. Define a mapping for joining methods where lugged joints are traditional, welded joints are strong, and monocoque construction is seamless. Define a list of aggressive riding postures containing aerodynamic tuck, sprinting drops, and climbing hoods. Evaluate a batch of bicycle frames to generate performance summaries. Example input: carbon fiber with aero tubes and monocoque construction. Expected output: vibration damping, ultra light, reduces wind drag, and seamless.

title: Bridge Load Calculator
spec: The entry function is `calculate(spans)`. Define a mapping for bridge types where a suspension bridge supports very long spans and sways, a beam bridge supports short spans and remains rigid, and an arch bridge supports medium spans and transfers weight outwards. Define a mapping for material strengths where reinforced concrete handles high compression, structural steel handles high tension, and treated timber handles light local traffic. Define a mapping for foundation types where shallow footings are for bedrock, driven piles are for soft soil, and drilled shafts are for deep stability. Define a list of dynamic loads containing heavy wind gusts, traffic jams, and seismic tremors. Output a structural assessment for proposed bridge designs. Example input: an arch bridge made of reinforced concrete on driven piles. Expected output: supports medium spans, handles high compression, and suited for soft soil.

title: Elevator Traffic Simulator
spec: The entry function is `simulate(requests)`. Define a mapping for motor types where geared traction serves mid rise buildings at moderate speeds, gearless traction serves high rise buildings at rapid speeds, and hydraulic serves low rise buildings at slow speeds. Define a mapping for door configurations where center opening doors load quickly, side opening doors save shaft space, and vertical doors are for freight handling. Define a mapping for dispatch algorithms where collective control answers all calls in one direction, destination dispatch groups passengers by floor, and hall call answers on a first come basis. Define a list of special modes containing fire service, hospital emergency, and maintenance override. Generate performance profiles for elevator configurations. Example input: gearless traction with center opening doors and destination dispatch. Expected output: rapid speeds for high rise buildings, quick loading, and groups passengers by floor.

title: Water Filtration Specifier
spec: The entry function is `specify(contaminants)`. Define a mapping for sediment filters where a pleated filter traps large particles and is washable, a spun filter traps medium particles and is disposable, and a string wound filter traps fine particles and handles high pressure. Define a mapping for carbon stages where granular carbon removes odors, carbon block removes chlorine, and catalytic carbon removes chloramines. Define a mapping for advanced purifiers where reverse osmosis removes heavy metals, ultraviolet light neutralizes bacteria, and ultrafiltration removes cysts. Define a list of dissolved solids containing calcium, magnesium, and sodium. Formulate a multi stage filtration plan based on a water quality report. Example input: a spun filter, a carbon block, and reverse osmosis. Expected output: traps medium particles, removes chlorine, and removes heavy metals.

title: Battery Storage Sizer
spec: The entry function is `size(demands)`. Define a mapping for chemistries where lead acid provides low upfront cost and short lifespan, lithium iron phosphate provides high safety and long lifespan, and nickel metal hydride provides extreme temperature tolerance. Define a mapping for discharge rates where a one hour rate yields low efficiency, a ten hour rate yields moderate efficiency, and a twenty hour rate yields maximum efficiency. Define a mapping for enclosure types where indoor racks are ventilated, outdoor cabinets are weather sealed, and underground vaults are temperature stable. Define a list of maintenance tasks containing equalizing charges, terminal cleaning, and fluid top offs. Design an energy storage profile based on load requirements. Example input: lithium iron phosphate, a ten hour rate, and an indoor rack. Expected output: high safety, long lifespan, moderate efficiency, and ventilated.

title: Drone Payload Estimator
spec: The entry function is `estimate(missions)`. Define a mapping for frame sizes where a micro frame carries fifty grams and flies indoors, a standard frame carries one kilogram and shoots video, and a heavy lift frame carries ten kilograms and maps terrain. Define a mapping for motor kv ratings where high kv spins fast and lifts light loads, medium kv balances speed and torque, and low kv spins slowly and swings large propellers. Define a mapping for battery configurations where a four cell pack provides fourteen volts, a six cell pack provides twenty two volts, and an eight cell pack provides twenty nine volts. Define a list of environmental hazards containing high winds, magnetic interference, and freezing rain. Calculate the flight capability for different drone configurations. Example input: a standard frame with medium kv motors and a six cell pack. Expected output: carries one kilogram, balances speed and torque, and provides twenty two volts.

title: Acoustic Panel Arranger
spec: The entry function is `arrange(rooms)`. Define a mapping for absorption materials where open cell foam absorbs high frequencies and is cheap, rigid fiberglass absorbs mid frequencies and is dense, and mineral wool absorbs low frequencies and is heavy. Define a mapping for panel thicknesses where one inch panels fix flutter echo, two inch panels handle voice ranges, and four inch panels act as bass traps. Define a mapping for mounting styles where flush mount saves space, an air gap increases low end absorption, and cloud suspension treats ceiling reflections. Define a list of acoustic anomalies containing comb filtering, room modes, and slapback echo. Output an acoustic treatment strategy for various studio spaces. Example input: rigid fiberglass, two inch panels, and an air gap. Expected output: absorbs mid frequencies, handles voice ranges, and increases low end absorption.

title: Paint Mixing Formulator
spec: The entry function is `formulate(colors)`. Define a mapping for paint finishes where flat hides wall imperfections and is hard to clean, satin reflects some light and is washable, and high gloss is highly reflective and highlights flaws. Define a mapping for binder bases where hundred percent acrylic resists fading, vinyl acrylic is cost effective, and alkyd provides a hard enameled surface. Define a mapping for pigment loads where pastel requires a white base, midtone requires a medium base, and deep requires a clear base. Define a list of functional additives containing mildewcide, self leveling agents, and quick dry accelerators. Produce paint mix instructions for different interior design requests. Example input: satin finish, hundred percent acrylic, and a deep pigment load. Expected output: reflects some light, resists fading, and requires a clear base.

title: Telescope Eyepiece Matcher
spec: The entry function is `match(optics)`. Define a mapping for optical designs where a plossl offers a fifty degree field and short eye relief, an orthoscopic offers sharp planetary views and a narrow field, and a nagler offers an eighty two degree field and immersive views. Define a mapping for barrel diameters where one and a quarter inches fits standard focusers, two inches prevents vignetting on wide views, and three inches is for specialized astrophotography. Define a mapping for lens coatings where fully coated reduces some glare, multi coated improves contrast, and fully multi coated maximizes light transmission. Define a list of celestial targets containing the moon, jupiter, and the orion nebula. Match observer preferences to the correct eyepiece specifications. Example input: a plossl design, a two inch barrel, and fully multi coated lenses. Expected output: fifty degree field, prevents vignetting, and maximizes light transmission.

title: Climbing Rope Selector
spec: The entry function is `select(routes)`. Define a mapping for rope categories where a single rope is used alone and is thick, a half rope is used in pairs to reduce drag, and a twin rope is clipped together for maximum security. Define a mapping for core treatments where untreated absorbs water quickly, dry treated resists water and dirt, and ultra dry prevents freezing in alpine conditions. Define a mapping for elongation types where static ropes are for hauling, low stretch ropes are for caving, and dynamic ropes absorb falling impacts. Define a list of high risk scenarios containing sharp edges, rock fall, and crevasse rescue. Recommend the appropriate climbing rope based on expedition details. Example input: a single rope, dry treated, and dynamic elongation. Expected output: used alone, resists water, and absorbs falling impacts.

title: Greenhouse Glazing Planner
spec: The entry function is `plan(climates)`. Define a mapping for glazing materials where tempered glass has maximum light transmission and high weight, polycarbonate has impact resistance and medium weight, and polyethylene film has low cost and short lifespan. Define a mapping for insulation layers where a single wall provides basic shelter, a double wall retains heat overnight, and a triple wall is suited for extreme winters. Define a mapping for frame materials where cedar wood naturally resists rot, galvanized steel supports heavy snow loads, and extruded aluminum will never rust. Define a list of passive ventilation methods containing roof vents, louvered side panels, and roll up walls. Propose a structural plan for agricultural greenhouses. Example input: polycarbonate, a double wall, and an extruded aluminum frame. Expected output: impact resistance, retains heat overnight, and will never rust.

title: Fireplace Flue Sizer
spec: The entry function is `size(hearths)`. Define a mapping for fuel types where seasoned wood produces high creosote and tall flames, natural gas burns clean and produces water vapor, and wood pellets offer controlled burns and minimal ash. Define a mapping for draft systems where a natural draft relies on heat rising, a direct vent pulls outside air, and an induced draft uses an electric fan. Define a mapping for liner materials where clay tiles are traditional but crack over time, aluminum is only for gas appliances, and stainless steel resists all corrosive byproducts. Define a list of chimney hazards containing bird nests, heavy soot buildup, and downdrafts. Determine the safe venting configuration for different fireplace installations. Example input: natural gas, a direct vent, and an aluminum liner. Expected output: burns clean, pulls outside air, and only for gas appliances.

title: Network Protocol Ports
spec: Analyze network traffic tuples containing protocol name and port. Maintain an internal registry of standard ports mapped to their expected protocol names, including secure shell on 22, hyper text transfer on 80, secure hyper text transfer on 443, file transfer on 21, domain name service on 53, simple mail transfer on 25, post office protocol on 110, and internet message access on 143. Maintain a separate registry of transport layer types mapping transmission control to secure shell, hyper text transfer, secure hyper text transfer, file transfer, simple mail transfer, post office protocol, and internet message access, and user datagram to domain name service. The `audit(traffic)` function should iterate through the traffic tuples, verify if the port matches the standard registry, and return a list of lists where each inner list contains the protocol name, its transport layer type, and a boolean indicating if the port is standard. For example, providing a list with a tuple of secure shell and 22 should return a list containing a list of secure shell, transmission control, and true.

title: Cloud Resource Limits
spec: Evaluate cloud resource requests against predefined limits for different subscription tiers. Define free tier limits as 1 processor, 1 gigabyte of memory, and 10 gigabytes of storage, basic tier as 2, 4, and 50, professional tier as 8, 16, and 500, enterprise tier as 32, 64, and 2000, compute optimized as 64, 32, and 500, memory optimized as 16, 128, and 1000, storage optimized as 8, 32, and 10000, and machine learning tier as 128, 256, and 5000. The `provision(requests)` function receives a list of tuples containing the tier name and requested processors, memory, and storage. It must return a list of boolean values indicating whether each request falls completely within the allowed limits of its respective tier. For example, a basic request for 1 processor, 2 memory, and 20 storage returns true, while a basic request for 10 processors returns false.

title: Automotive Fluid Specs
spec: Validate automotive maintenance records against standard fluid capacities and types. The system must recognize compact cars requiring 4 liters of synthetic oil and 7 liters of coolant, midsize sedans requiring 5 liters of synthetic blend oil and 9 liters of coolant, and heavy duty trucks requiring 12 liters of conventional oil and 20 liters of coolant. It must also map sports cars to 6 liters of full synthetic and 10 of coolant, luxury suvs to 8 synthetic and 14 coolant, hybrids to 3 low viscosity and 5 coolant, electric vehicles to 0 oil and 10 battery coolant, and minivans to 5 conventional and 11 coolant. The `evaluate(vehicles)` function takes a list of records, where each is a tuple of vehicle class, added oil type, added oil volume, and added coolant volume. Return a list of tuples containing the vehicle class and a string stating either compliant or noncompliant based on exact matches for both fluid types and volumes, where a compact car with 4 liters of synthetic oil and 7 liters of coolant returns compact car and compliant.

title: Camera Film Stocks
spec: Determine the correct development process and time for various photographic films. The logic must map color negative to process c41 taking 195 seconds, black and white classic to d76 taking 480 seconds, color reversal to e6 taking 360 seconds, and black and white tabular to tmax taking 420 seconds. It also maps instant color to monobath taking 300 seconds, infrared to hc110 taking 600 seconds, motion picture to ecn2 taking 180 seconds, and orthochromatic to rodinal taking 720 seconds. The `develop(rolls)` function takes a list of strings representing film types and returns a list of tuples, where each tuple contains the process name and the total development time in seconds. For example, an input list of color negative and black and white classic should return a list with tuples of c41 and 195, and d76 and 480.

title: Medical Contrast Agents
spec: Screen patients for medical imaging procedures based on contrast agent requirements. The reference data must specify that magnetic resonance imaging uses gadolinium checking for kidney failure, computed tomography uses iodine checking for thyroid issues and shellfish allergy, and positron emission tomography uses fluorodeoxyglucose checking for high blood sugar. Ultrasound uses microbubbles checking for heart conditions, fluoroscopy uses barium checking for bowel obstruction, angiography uses iodinated contrast checking for bleeding risk, arthrography uses gadolinium joint injection checking for joint infection, and myelography uses non ionic iodine checking for seizure history. The `screen(patients)` function accepts a list of tuples containing the imaging modality and a list of the patient medical conditions. Return a list of boolean values representing whether the patient is clear to proceed, meaning they have none of the conflicting conditions, so magnetic resonance imaging paired with a list containing kidney failure returns false.

title: Architectural Roof Styles
spec: Calculate roofing material requirements based on architectural styles and complexities. The base data should define a gable roof as having 2 sides and a multiplier of 1.2, a hip roof has 4 sides and a multiplier of 1.5, a mansard roof has 4 double slopes and a multiplier of 2.0, and a flat roof has 0 sides and a multiplier of 1.0. Furthermore, a shed roof has 1 side and 1.1, a gambrel roof has 2 double slopes and 1.7, a butterfly roof has 2 inverted slopes and 2.5, and a dome has a continuous surface and 3.0. The `estimate(structures)` function receives a list of tuples containing roof style and base square footage. Return a list of calculated total costs, assuming a fixed material rate of 10 dollars per square foot multiplied by the complexity multiplier, meaning a flat roof of 1000 square feet returns 10000.0.

title: Geological Fault Regimes
spec: Classify geological fault lines based on their stress regimes and movement. Store reference information mapping normal faults to extensional stress and vertical downward movement, reverse faults to compressional stress and vertical upward movement, and strike slip faults to shear stress and horizontal movement. Also map oblique faults to mixed stress and diagonal movement, thrust faults to compressional stress and shallow upward movement, listric faults to extensional stress and curved downward movement, detachment faults to extensional stress and nearly horizontal movement, and transform faults to shear stress and plate boundary horizontal movement. The `classify(faults)` function receives a list of observed faults, each given as a tuple of stress type and movement direction. It should return a list of matched fault names, so an input of shear stress and horizontal movement returns strike slip.

title: Aircraft Engine Types
spec: Determine the optimal altitude and speed characteristics for different aircraft engines. The system maps a turboprop engine to a maximum altitude of 30000 feet and low speed, a turbofan to 45000 feet and high subsonic speed, a turbojet to 60000 feet and supersonic speed, and a ramjet to 80000 feet and hypersonic speed. It also maps a scramjet to 100000 feet and high hypersonic speed, a pulsejet to 20000 feet and low subsonic speed, a piston to 15000 feet and low speed, and an electric engine to 10000 feet and ultra low speed. The `analyze(engines)` function processes a list of tuples containing the engine type and current altitude. Return a list of strings indicating optimal if the current altitude is below the maximum altitude for that engine type, and sub-optimal otherwise, meaning a turboprop at 40000 feet returns sub-optimal.

title: Database Isolation Levels
spec: Evaluate database transaction isolation levels against read phenomena. Define read uncommitted as allowing dirty, non repeatable, and phantom reads, read committed as preventing dirty reads, and repeatable read as preventing dirty and non repeatable reads. Define serializable as preventing all three, snapshot isolation as preventing dirty, non repeatable, and phantom but allowing write skew, read write as allowing all, read only as allowing none, and strict serializable as preventing all with real time ordering. The `validate(transactions)` function receives a list of tuples containing an isolation level and a specific read phenomenon encountered. It must return a list of boolean values indicating whether the encountered phenomenon is a violation of that isolation level, such that read uncommitted and dirty read returns false, while serializable and phantom read returns true.

title: Cryptographic Hash Parameters
spec: Verify cryptographic hash function parameters for security audits. The reference definitions must include message digest five with a block size of 512 and digest size of 128, secure hash one with 512 and 160, secure hash two fifty six with 512 and 256, and secure hash five twelve with 1024 and 512. It must also include secure hash three two fifty six with 1088 and 256, secure hash three five twelve with 576 and 512, blake two b with 1024 and 512, and ripemd one sixty with 512 and 160. The `verify(algorithms)` function accepts a list of hash names. It returns a list of tuples containing the block size and digest size for each, so an input of message digest five should return a list containing a tuple of 512 and 128.

title: Ocean Zone Depths
spec: Categorize marine life sightings based on depth zones in the ocean. Define the surface zone from 0 to 50 meters, epipelagic zone from 50 to 200 meters, mesopelagic zone from 200 to 1000 meters, and bathypelagic zone from 1000 to 4000 meters. Also define abyssopelagic zone from 4000 to 6000 meters, hadalpelagic zone from 6000 to 11000 meters, trench bottom from 11000 to 12000 meters, and core boundary for anything over 12000 meters. The `explore(dives)` function takes a list of observation depths in meters and returns a list of strings representing the names of the corresponding ocean zones, meaning a depth of 150 meters returns epipelagic zone.

title: Printing Press Color Models
spec: Translate color specifications between different printing press models. Maintain a registry mapping spot colors to their primary cyan, magenta, yellow, and black mixtures, where rich black uses 100 of all four, standard red uses 0 cyan, 100 magenta, 100 yellow, and 0 black, deep blue uses 100 cyan, 100 magenta, 0 yellow, and 0 black, and forest green uses 100 cyan, 0 magenta, 100 yellow, and 50 black. Add warm yellow using 0, 20, 100, and 0, cool gray using 0, 0, 0, and 50, bright orange using 0, 60, 100, and 0, and royal purple using 75, 100, 0, and 0. The `convert(colors)` function takes a list of spot color names. It must return a list of tuples containing the four percentage values for each requested spot color, meaning requesting standard red returns a list containing a tuple of 0, 100, 100, and 0.

title: Synthesizer Waveforms
spec: Process audio synthesizer signals based on fundamental waveform properties. Define a sine wave as having odd harmonics and smooth attack, square wave as odd harmonics and sudden attack, sawtooth wave as odd and even harmonics and sudden attack, and triangle wave as odd harmonics and rapid roll off attack. Additionally, a pulse wave has even harmonics and sharp attack, white noise has all harmonics and random attack, pink noise has low frequency harmonics and random attack, and a super saw has multiple detuned harmonics and thick attack. The `modulate(signals)` function receives a list of tuples containing a waveform name and a base frequency. It returns a list of tuples with the base frequency, the harmonics string, and the attack string, so inputting sine wave and 440 returns a tuple of 440, odd harmonics, and smooth attack.

title: Metamorphic Rock Facies
spec: Grade geological rock samples according to their metamorphic facies and pressure temperature conditions. Include greenschist facies forming under low pressure and low temperature, amphibolite facies under medium pressure and medium temperature, granulite facies under medium pressure and high temperature, and blueschist facies under high pressure and low temperature. Also include eclogite facies under high pressure and high temperature, zeolite facies under very low pressure and very low temperature, prehnite pumpellyite facies under low pressure and very low temperature, and hornfels facies under low pressure and high temperature. The `grade(samples)` function takes a list of rock samples represented as tuples of pressure level and temperature level. It returns a list of facies names that match the conditions, so low pressure and low temperature returns greenschist facies.

title: Web Browser Engines
spec: Route user agents to specific rendering pipelines based on browser engine families. Map the blink engine to chrome, edge, and opera, the gecko engine to firefox, waterfox, and icecat, the webkit engine to safari, epiphany, and maxthon, and the goanna engine to palemoon, basilisk, and k meleon. Map trident to internet explorer, maxthon classic, and aol, presto to opera classic, nintendo ds, and wii, servo to servo nightly, magicleap, and firefox reality, and khtml to konqueror, arora, and rekonq. The `render(clients)` function receives a list of browser names extracted from user agents. It returns a list of engine names corresponding to each browser, so providing a list of chrome and firefox returns a list containing blink and gecko.

title: Hydroelectric Dam Types
spec: Assess the suitability of hydroelectric dam types for various valley profiles. Establish rules where a gravity dam requires a wide rock foundation and massive concrete weight, an arch dam requires a narrow canyon and structural curvature, a buttress dam requires a wide valley and spaced triangular supports, and an earthfill dam requires a broad floodplain and compacted soil. A rockfill dam requires a seismic zone and loose rock with core, a barrage dam requires a flat river bed and adjustable gates, a detention dam requires a dry valley and flood control gates, and a diversion dam requires a steep mountain stream and minimal reservoir. The `assess(structures)` function receives a list of tuples describing valley type and material mechanism. It returns a list of suitable dam types, meaning a narrow canyon and structural curvature returns arch dam.

title: Typography Font Classifications
spec: Determine the appropriate use cases for different typography font classifications. Define serif fonts as having decorative strokes for long printed texts, sans serif fonts as clean edges for digital user interfaces, script fonts as mimicking handwriting for formal invitations, and monospace fonts as uniform widths for computer code. Define display fonts as large size for poster headings, blackletter fonts as gothic style for classic certificates, slab serif fonts as thick block strokes for advertising banners, and handwritten fonts as casual strokes for personal notes. The `typeset(fonts)` function takes a list of font classifications and returns a list of their recommended use cases, where passing monospace returns uniform widths for computer code.

title: Agricultural Fertilizer NPK
spec: Recommend fertilizer mixtures based on crop nutrient requirements for nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium. Maintain a catalog where a starter blend is 10, 20, and 10, a vegetative blend is 20, 10, and 10, a flowering blend is 10, 10, and 20, and a balanced blend is 15, 15, and 15. Also include a fruiting blend of 5, 15, and 25, a root growth blend of 5, 25, and 5, a winterizing blend of 5, 10, and 20, and a transition blend of 12, 12, and 12. The `fertilize(crops)` function accepts a list of required blend names. It returns a list of tuples containing the three nutrient percentages for each requested blend, meaning an input of starter returns a tuple of 10, 20, and 10.

title: Electrical Plug Sockets
spec: Determine electrical adapter requirements for international travelers. Store a registry where type a plugs have two flat parallel pins at 120 volts, type c plugs have two round pins at 230 volts, type g plugs have three rectangular pins at 230 volts, and type i plugs have two flat inverted v pins at 230 volts. Add type b plugs with two flat parallel pins with ground at 120 volts, type e with two round pins with earth pin at 230 volts, type f with two round pins with earth clips at 230 volts, and type h with three round pins in a triangle at 230 volts. The `adapt(travelers)` function receives a list of target plug types. It returns a list of tuples containing the pin description and the operating voltage for each requested plug type, meaning requesting type c returns a tuple of two round pins and 230.

title: Vintage Computer Buses
spec: Validate peripheral connections against vintage computer expansion bus architectures. The architecture defines the industry standard architecture bus as 16 bits and 8 megahertz, micro channel architecture as 32 bits and 10 megahertz, extended industry standard architecture as 32 bits and 8 megahertz, and peripheral component interconnect as 32 bits and 33 megahertz. It also defines accelerated graphics port as 32 bits and 66 megahertz, peripheral component interconnect express as 64 bits and 100 megahertz, video local bus as 32 bits and 40 megahertz, and nu bus as 32 bits and 10 megahertz. The `interface(peripherals)` function receives a list of peripheral requirements given as tuples of required bit width and minimum speed. Return a list of all compatible bus names that meet or exceed both the width and speed requirements, where a requirement of 16 bits and 8 megahertz includes industry standard architecture among the results.

title: Subatomic Quark Flavors
spec: Calculate the total electric charge of composite particles based on their constituent quarks. Map the up quark to a charge of 2/3, down to -1/3, strange to -1/3, anti up to -2/3, anti down to 1/3, and anti strange to 1/3. Establish the quark content of hadrons where a proton has two up and one down, a neutron has one up and two down, a positive pion has one up and one anti down, a negative pion has one anti up and one down, a positive kaon has one up and one anti strange, a negative kaon has one anti up and one strange, a lambda baryon has one up one down and one strange, and an omega baryon has three strange quarks. The `construct(hadrons)` function accepts a list of hadron names. It must calculate the sum of the charges of the respective quarks, round the result to the nearest whole integer, and return a list of these total integer charges, where a proton returns 1.

title: Rocket Propellant Combinations
spec: Determine the primary exhaust products for various rocket propellant combinations. Store configurations where liquid oxygen and liquid hydrogen produce water vapor, liquid oxygen and kerosene produce carbon dioxide, nitrogen tetroxide and hydrazine produce nitrogen gas, and nitrous oxide and solid rubber produce mixed exhaust. Further include liquid fluorine and liquid hydrogen producing hydrogen fluoride, hydrogen peroxide and kerosene producing steam and carbon dioxide, liquid oxygen and methane producing carbon dioxide and water, and aerozine and nitrogen tetroxide producing nitrogen and water. The `launch(stages)` function receives a list of tuples containing two propellants. It must return a list of strings describing the primary exhaust product for each recognized propellant pair, where liquid oxygen and liquid hydrogen returns water vapor.

title: Watercraft Hull Designs
spec: Evaluate the performance characteristics of different watercraft hull designs. A flat bottom hull exhibits high stability and low draft, a round bottom hull exhibits low stability and smooth movement, a vee bottom hull cuts waves and needs power, and a multi hull exhibits exceptional stability and minimal resistance. A cathedral hull provides triple vee rough water stability, a tunnel hull operates on an air cushion for high speed, a pontoon uses tubular floats for maximum deck space, and a stepped hull uses an aerated bottom for reduced drag. The `navigate(vessels)` function takes a list of vessel designs. Return a list of tuples containing the primary and secondary performance characteristics for each design, meaning a flat bottom hull returns a tuple of high stability and low draft.

title: Forestry Leaf Arrangements
spec: Identify tree species based on their leaf arrangements and shapes. Establish a database where an alternate arrangement with lobed leaves points to an oak tree, opposite with palmate leaves indicates a maple tree, alternate with oval serrated leaves suggests an elm tree, and whorled with heart shaped leaves identifies a catalpa tree. Furthermore, opposite with pinnately compound leaves indicates an ash tree, alternate with pinnately compound leaves suggests a hickory tree, fascicled with needle like leaves points to a pine tree, and scale like overlapping leaves identifies a cedar tree. The `identify(trees)` function receives a list of tuples containing the leaf arrangement and leaf shape. It returns a list of tree names that match the characteristics, meaning alternate and lobed returns oak tree.

title: Intellectual Property Types
spec: Determine the appropriate intellectual property protection for creative and technical works. Utility patents protect inventions for 20 years, design patents protect ornamental designs for 15 years, copyrights protect artistic works for 70 years after death, and trademarks protect brand names indefinitely with use. Trade secrets protect confidential info indefinitely with secrecy, geographical indications protect regional goods indefinitely with registration, plant patents protect new plant varieties for 20 years, and industrial designs protect product aesthetics for 10 years. The `protect(assets)` function receives a list of protection type names. It returns a list of tuples containing the protected subject matter and the duration, so an input of utility patent returns a list containing a tuple of inventions and 20 years.

title: Construction Material Evaluator
spec: Write a module to classify construction materials. It must contain an entry function `evaluate(material)` that returns a tuple of its density in kilograms per cubic meter, cost category, and fire rating. Support the following exact materials: concrete (density 2400, low cost, excellent rating), steel (7850, high, poor), timber (600, medium, poor), brick (1900, medium, excellent), glass (2500, high, poor), aluminum (2700, high, poor), fiberglass (1500, medium, medium), and plaster (800, low, excellent). If the material is unknown, return zero, unknown, and unknown. Examples: concrete returns (2400, low, excellent).

title: Cocktail Recipe Mixer
spec: Develop a module for a bartending application. The entry function `mix(order)` must accept a cocktail name and return a tuple of its primary spirit, mixer, and standard garnish. The menu handles margarita (tequila, lime juice, salt rim), martini (gin, vermouth, olive), mojito (rum, mint, lime wedge), old fashioned (bourbon, bitters, orange peel), moscow mule (vodka, ginger beer, lime wedge), negroni (gin, campari, orange peel), daiquiri (rum, lime juice, lime wheel), and manhattan (rye, vermouth, cherry). Unrecognized drinks return none for all attributes. Examples: margarita returns (tequila, lime juice, salt rim).

title: Origami Base Classifier
spec: Create a module to categorize traditional origami bases. Function `fold(base)` must return a tuple of the standard initial crease pattern shape, number of structural flaps, and geometric symmetry. Define kite (diagonal shape, two flaps, bilateral symmetry), preliminary (square, four, radial), waterbomb (triangle, four, radial), bird (diamond, four, bilateral), frog (square, eight, radial), fish (diamond, two, bilateral), blintz (square, four, radial), and windmill (pinwheel, four, rotational). Unrecognized bases return unknown, zero, and none. Examples: waterbomb returns (triangle, 4, radial).

title: Historical Sailing Ships
spec: Write a module to classify historical ships. A function `fleet(ship)` returns a tuple of mast count, primary sail plan, and intended historical role. The supported types are schooner (two masts, fore-and-aft sails, fishing role), sloop (one, fore-and-aft, coastal transport), brigantine (two, mixed, piracy), galleon (three, square, treasure transport), clipper (three, square, rapid trade), caravel (two, lateen, exploration), cog (one, square, medieval trade), and frigate (three, square, naval escort). Unknown classifications return zero, unknown, and unknown. Examples: clipper returns (3, square, rapid trade).

title: Bread Type Profiler
spec: Develop a baking module. The function `bake(bread)` returns a tuple of the country of origin, primary flour, and hydration level as a percentage. Handled breads include baguette (France, wheat flour, seventy percent hydration), ciabatta (Italy, wheat, eighty), pumpernickel (Germany, rye, eighty), pita (Middle East, wheat, sixty), focaccia (Italy, wheat, seventy five), sourdough (Egypt, wheat, seventy), brioche (France, enriched wheat, sixty), and injera (Ethiopia, teff, one hundred). Unrecognized breads return unknown, unknown, and zero. Examples: ciabatta returns (Italy, wheat, 80).

title: Logic Gate Simulator
spec: Create a logic simulation module. The function `simulate(gate)` handles logic operations and returns a tuple of four binary truth table outputs for the input pairs zero-zero, zero-one, one-zero, and one-one. It must support and (zero, zero, zero, one), or (zero, one, one, one), nand (one, one, one, zero), nor (one, zero, zero, zero), xor (zero, one, one, zero), xnor (one, zero, zero, one), imply (one, one, zero, one), and nimply (zero, zero, one, zero). Unknown gates should return four zeros. Examples: xor returns (0, 1, 1, 0).

title: Architectural Column Orders
spec: Write a module for classical architecture. The function `column(order)` returns a tuple of the base type, capital style, and a boolean indicating if it has fluting for a given architectural order. The supported orders are doric (none base, plain capital, true fluting), ionic (molded, volutes, true), corinthian (molded, acanthus leaves, true), tuscan (simple, plain, false), composite (molded, volutes and leaves, true), aeolic (molded, palmettes, true), solomonic (molded, twisted, false), and caryatid (sculpted figure, basket, false). If not found, return unknown, unknown, and false. Examples: ionic returns (molded, volutes, true).

title: Cloud Type Categorizer
spec: Develop a meteorology module. The function `weather(cloud)` must return a tuple of altitude category, shape, and precipitation likelihood. The data must include cirrus (high altitude, wispy shape, none precipitation), stratus (low, flat, light), cumulus (low, puffy, none), nimbus (low, dark, heavy), altocumulus (middle, patched, none), cirrostratus (high, halo, none), stratocumulus (low, lumpy, light), and cumulonimbus (vertical, towering, heavy). Unknown clouds return unknown for all string values. Examples: cirrus returns (high, wispy, none).

title: Snowflake Shape Profiler
spec: Create a module to classify ice crystals. Function `crystal(shape)` returns a tuple of the formation temperature in celsius, primary growth axis, and visual density. Handle stellar dendrite (minus fifteen, planar axis, low density), sectored plate (minus fifteen, planar, medium), hollow column (minus eight, columnar, high), spatial dendrite (minus twenty, irregular, low), capped column (minus twelve, mixed, medium), rimed (minus ten, heavily coated, very high), triangular (minus fourteen, planar, medium), and bullet rosette (minus twenty five, multi columnar, low). For unknown shapes, return zero, unknown, and unknown. Examples: hollow column returns (-8, columnar, high).

title: Pasta Sauce Profiles
spec: Write a culinary module. The function `sauce(name)` returns a tuple of the base liquid ingredient, primary herb, and thickness profile. Supported sauces include marinara (tomato base, basil herb, thin thickness), alfredo (cream, parsley, thick), pesto (olive oil, basil, thick), carbonara (egg, black pepper, medium), bolognese (meat, oregano, thick), arrabbiata (tomato, chili, medium), puttanesca (tomato, capers, medium), and vodka (cream and tomato, basil, medium). If unrecognized, return unknown for all elements. Examples: pesto returns (olive oil, basil, thick).

title: Standard Paper Sizes
spec: Develop a module for standard dimensions. The function `paper(size)` accepts a paper size identifier and returns a tuple of its width and height in millimeters. The exact dimensions are a zero (eight hundred forty one width, one thousand one hundred eighty nine height), a one (five hundred ninety four, eight hundred forty one), a two (four hundred twenty, five hundred ninety four), a three (two hundred ninety seven, four hundred twenty), a four (two hundred ten, two hundred ninety seven), a five (one hundred forty eight, two hundred ten), a six (one hundred five, one hundred forty eight), and a seven (seventy four, one hundred five). For any other size, return zero and zero. Examples: a four returns (210, 297).

title: Wedding Anniversary Traditions
spec: Create a module for anniversary traditions. The function `anniversary(year)` returns a tuple of the traditional gift material, modern alternative, and symbolic color for a given year number. The logic covers year one (paper traditional, clocks modern, yellow color), year two (cotton, china, red), year three (leather, crystal, white), year four (fruit, appliances, blue), year five (wood, silverware, pink), year six (iron, wood, purple), year seven (copper, desk sets, yellow), and year eight (bronze, linens, bronze). Unlisted years return unknown for all values. Examples: year five returns (wood, silverware, pink).

title: Bowling Ball Coverstocks
spec: Write a sports equipment module. The function `bowling(cover)` accepts a bowling ball coverstock and returns a tuple of its friction level, physical durability, and hook potential. Include plastic (low friction, high durability, low hook), urethane (medium, high, medium), reactive solid (high, medium, high), reactive pearl (medium, medium, medium), reactive hybrid (high, medium, high), particle (very high, low, very high), proactive (very high, low, very high), and resin (high, medium, high). Return unknown for all if the material is not recognized. Examples: plastic returns (low, high, low).

title: Shoe Lacing Styles
spec: Develop a module for footwear styling. The function `lace(style)` returns a tuple of required lace length category, tightness level, and visual complexity. Support crisscross (long length, high tightness, simple complexity), straight (medium, medium, simple), bar (short, low, simple), display (short, low, complex), lattice (very long, high, very complex), bowtie (short, low, simple), loop (medium, high, complex), and checkerboard (very long, medium, very complex). For unknown styles, return unknown. Examples: crisscross returns (long, high, simple).

title: Honey Variety Traits
spec: Create an apiary module. The function `honey(variety)` returns a tuple of color grade, flavor profile, and crystallization speed. Handle clover (light color, mild flavor, fast speed), manuka (dark, earthy, slow), orange blossom (light, citrus, medium), tupelo (light, buttery, very slow), buckwheat (very dark, robust, slow), acacia (very light, sweet, very slow), sage (light, mild, slow), and lavender (medium, floral, medium). If the variety is not listed, return unknown. Examples: tupelo returns (light, buttery, very slow).

title: Egyptian Pantheon Roles
spec: Write a mythology module. The function `pantheon(god)` returns a tuple of the primary domain of an ancient Egyptian deity, their associated animal head, and main held symbol. The rules must define ra (sun domain, falcon head, sun disk symbol), osiris (underworld, none, crook and flail), isis (magic, none, throne), anubis (embalming, jackal, ankh), horus (sky, falcon, eye of horus), thoth (wisdom, ibis, stylus), sekhmet (war, lioness, sun disk), and seth (chaos, set animal, was scepter). Unrecognized gods return unknown, none, and unknown. Examples: anubis returns (embalming, jackal, ankh).

title: Bindery Fold Formats
spec: Develop a printing module. The function `bindery(fold)` returns a tuple of resulting panel count, fold direction, and common use case. Handle half (two panels, single direction, greeting cards use), tri (three, spiral, brochures), z (three, alternating, letters), gate (four, meeting, invitations), double parallel (four, parallel, maps), roll (four, inward spiral, thick brochures), accordion (four or more, alternating, pamphlets), and map (eight, cross, large maps). If not recognized, return zero, unknown, and unknown. Examples: z returns (3, alternating, letters).

title: Salsa Dance Styles
spec: Create a dance styling module. The function `salsa(style)` returns a tuple of the break beat number, floor pattern, and cultural origin. Support cuban (one beat, circular pattern, cuba origin), new york (two, slotted, united states), la (one, slotted, united states), colombian (one, circular, colombia), miami (one, circular, united states), rueda (one, circular group, cuba), puerto rican (two, slotted, puerto rico), and casino (one, circular, cuba). Unknown styles return zero, unknown, and unknown. Examples: new york returns (2, slotted, united states).

title: Mattress Size Dimensions
spec: Write a bedding module. The function `mattress(size)` accepts a size name and returns a tuple of its standard width and length in inches. The supported sizes must be twin (thirty eight width, seventy five length), twin extra long (thirty eight, eighty), full (fifty four, seventy five), queen (sixty, eighty), king (seventy six, eighty), california king (seventy two, eighty four), olympic queen (sixty six, eighty), and alaskan king (one hundred eight, one hundred eight). Unrecognized sizes return zero and zero. Examples: queen returns (60, 80).

title: Historical Sword Designs
spec: Develop a weaponry module. The function `sword(type)` returns a tuple of average blade length in centimeters, hilt style, and primary usage. Define gladius (sixty length, single hand hilt, thrusting usage), spatha (eighty, single hand, slashing), falchion (seventy, single hand, chopping), rapier (one hundred, complex guard, thrusting), broadsword (eighty, basket hilt, slashing), longsword (one hundred, two hand, mixed), claymore (one hundred thirty, crossguard, slashing), and cutlass (seventy, cup hilt, slashing). Unrecognized swords return zero, unknown, and unknown. Examples: rapier returns (100, complex guard, thrusting).

title: Typewriter Ribbon Specs
spec: Create an antique equipment module. The function `ribbon(material)` returns a tuple of ink longevity, a boolean for reusability, and correction difficulty. Support silk (very high longevity, true reusable, hard correction), cotton (high, true, medium), nylon (medium, true, medium), carbon film (low, false, easy), wax thermal (medium, false, hard), fabric (high, true, medium), poly film (low, false, easy), and metallic (high, false, hard). Unlisted ribbons return unknown, false, and unknown. Examples: nylon returns (medium, true, medium).

title: Candle Wax Properties
spec: Write a candle making module. The function `wax(type)` returns a tuple of general melt point in fahrenheit, soot production level, and scent throw capability. The logic handles paraffin (one hundred thirty point, high soot, excellent scent), soy (one hundred twenty, low, good), beeswax (one hundred forty five, very low, poor), palm (one hundred forty, low, excellent), gel (one hundred sixty, low, good), coconut (one hundred, low, excellent), stearin (one hundred fifty, low, good), and rapeseed (one hundred twenty, low, good). Return zero, unknown, and unknown if absent. Examples: soy returns (120, low, good).

title: Musical Clef Anchors
spec: Develop a music theory module. The function `clef(name)` returns a tuple of the anchor line number from the bottom, anchor note, and typical instrument group. Define treble (two line, g note, high woodwinds instruments), bass (four, f, low brass), alto (three, c, violas), tenor (four, c, bassoons), soprano (one, c, historical voices), mezzo soprano (two, c, historical voices), baritone (five, c, historical horns), and subbass (five, f, historical low brass). Unrecognized clefs return zero, unknown, and unknown. Examples: treble returns (2, g, high woodwinds).

title: Microphone Polar Patterns
spec: Create an audio engineering module. The function `microphone(pattern)` returns a tuple of front sensitivity, rear sensitivity, and side sensitivity. Use high, medium, low, and none. Handled patterns are omnidirectional (high front, high rear, high side), cardioid (high, none, low), supercardioid (high, low, low), hypercardioid (high, medium, low), figure eight (high, high, none), subcardioid (high, medium, medium), shotgun (high, low, none), and boundary (high, none, none). Return unknown for missing patterns. Examples: cardioid returns (high, none, low).

title: Billiard Game Rules
spec: Write a tabletop sports module. The function `billiards(game)` returns a tuple of the number of object balls used, a boolean for whether it requires calling pockets, and the winning condition. Include eight ball (fifteen balls, true call, sink eight ball win), nine ball (nine, false, sink nine ball), snooker (twenty one, true, highest score), straight pool (fifteen, true, reach point total), one pocket (fifteen, false, sink eight in target pocket), bank pool (fifteen, true, sink eight via banks), cutthroat (fifteen, false, last balls standing), and balkline (three, true, reach point total). Return zero, false, and unknown if not found. Examples: nine ball returns (9, false, sink nine ball).

title: RPG Character Stats
spec: Write a function `evaluate(character)` that calculates final stats for a video game character. The input character is a tuple containing class name, race name, and a list of equipped item names. Maintain internal data for four classes. The warrior has one hundred health and twenty mana. The mage has forty health and one hundred mana. The rogue has sixty health and forty mana. The cleric has eighty health and eighty mana. Maintain data for four races. Human adds ten health and ten mana. Elf adds zero health and twenty mana. Orc adds twenty health and zero mana. Dwarf adds fifteen health and five mana. Maintain data for four items. Sword adds five health. Staff adds ten mana. Shield adds fifteen health. Cloak adds five health and five mana. Return a tuple of final health and final mana. Example input: warrior, elf, and a list containing sword and shield. Example output: one hundred twenty for health, forty for mana.

title: Escape Room Score
spec: Write a function `score(attempts)` that evaluates a team performance in an escape room. The input is a list of tuples, where each tuple contains a room name, the minutes taken, and the number of hints used. Maintain internal data for four rooms. The library room has a par time of twenty minutes and allows two hints. The laboratory room has a par time of thirty minutes and allows three hints. The dungeon room has a par time of forty minutes and allows one hint. The vault room has a par time of fifteen minutes and allows zero hints. For each room attempted, a team scores one hundred points if they finish under the par time, minus ten points for each hint used. If they exceed the par time, they score fifty points minus twenty points per hint used. Negative room scores are floored at zero. Return a list of scores for each room attempt. Example input: a list with one tuple containing library, twenty five minutes, and one hint. Example output: a list with one score of thirty.

title: Cafe Menu Pricing
spec: Write a function `calculate(order)` that totals a cafe bill. The input is a list of tuples containing the beverage name, size, and milk type. Maintain internal data for four beverages. Espresso costs two dollars for small, three for medium, and four for large. Latte costs three dollars for small, four for medium, and five for large. Cappuccino costs three for small, four for medium, and four and a half for large. Mocha costs four for small, five for medium, and six for large. Maintain data for milk surcharges. Whole milk and skim milk add nothing. Soy milk adds fifty cents. Oat milk adds seventy five cents. Almond milk adds fifty cents. The function should calculate the price of each beverage based on its size and milk, then return the total cost as a float. Example input: a list with one tuple for a large latte with oat milk. Example output: five dollars and seventy five cents.

title: Planet Settlement Viability
spec: Write a function `assess(planets)` that evaluates potential planets for settlement. The input is a list of tuples containing planet name, atmosphere type, temperature in celsius, and water presence as a boolean. Maintain rules for four atmosphere types. A nitrogen oxygen atmosphere has a temperature range of negative twenty to positive forty. A carbon dioxide atmosphere has a range of negative fifty to positive ten. A methane atmosphere has a range of negative one hundred to negative fifty. An argon atmosphere has a range of zero to fifty. A planet is viable if it has water, and its temperature falls strictly within the bounds for its atmosphere type. Return a list of names of viable planets. Example input: a list with one tuple for a planet named Eden, nitrogen oxygen atmosphere, twenty degrees, and true for water. Example output: a list containing the string Eden.

title: Medieval Kingdom Taxes
spec: Write a function `tax(settlements)` that calculates tax revenue. The input is a list of tuples containing settlement name, settlement type, and population. Maintain tax rates for four settlement types. A village taxes at one gold per person and requires a population under five hundred. A town taxes at two gold per person and requires a population between five hundred and two thousand. A city taxes at three gold per person and requires a population between two thousand and ten thousand. A metropolis taxes at four gold per person and requires a population over ten thousand. If a settlement population does not match its type requirements, its tax rate is halved from the usual rate for its type. Return a list of gold collected for each settlement. Example input: a list with one tuple for a town with four hundred people. Example output: a list containing four hundred.

title: Sci-Fi Spaceship Cargo
spec: Write a function `load(manifest)` that determines if a spaceship can carry a set of cargo containers. The input manifest is a list of tuples containing container type and quantity. Maintain data for four container types. Food containers weigh two tons and take up three cubic meters. Machinery containers weigh five tons and take up two cubic meters. Medicine containers weigh one ton and take up one cubic meter. Weapon containers weigh four tons and take up four cubic meters. The spaceship has a maximum weight capacity of fifty tons and a maximum volume of sixty cubic meters. Calculate the total weight and volume of the manifest. Return a tuple containing a boolean indicating if the cargo fits, the total weight, and the total volume. Example input: a list with ten food containers. Example output: a tuple with true, twenty, and thirty.

title: Plant Fertilizer Calculator
spec: Write a function `formulate(plants)` that calculates total fertilizer needs. The input is a list of tuples containing plant type and soil area in square meters. Maintain data for four plant types. Tomatoes require two units of nitrogen, one unit of phosphorus, and two units of potassium per square meter. Carrots require one unit of nitrogen, two units of phosphorus, and one unit of potassium. Beans require zero units of nitrogen, one unit of phosphorus, and one unit of potassium. Corn requires three units of nitrogen, two units of phosphorus, and one unit of potassium. Multiply each plant requirements by its area and sum the totals for nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium. Return a tuple of total nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium required. Example input: a list with tomatoes at ten square meters. Example output: a tuple of twenty, ten, and twenty.

title: Fantasy Potion Crafting
spec: Write a function `brew(ingredients)` that determines the potion created from a list of ingredients. The input is a list of string ingredient names. Maintain data for four potions. A healing potion requires water, herbs, and a mushroom. A mana potion requires water, crystal, and a glowing root. A strength potion requires alcohol, bone, and a fiery leaf. An invisibility potion requires oil, a ghost feather, and a moonstone. For each potion, check if all required items are present in the input list. The input may contain extra items. Return the name of the first potion whose requirements are completely satisfied, checking in the order listed above. If none match, return the string sludge. Example input: water, herbs, mushroom, and a bone. Example output: the string healing.

title: Public Transit Fares
spec: Write a function `charge(trips)` that calculates the total cost of riding a transit network. The input is a list of tuples containing start zone, end zone, and rider category. Maintain base fares for four rider categories. An adult pays one hundred percent. A senior pays fifty percent. A student pays seventy five percent. A child pays twenty five percent. Maintain zone pair costs. North to north is two. North to central is three. North to south is five. Central to central is two. Central to south is three. South to south is two. Travel is reversible, so central to north is three. Multiply the zone cost by the rider category percentage to get the final fare for each trip. Return the sum of all fares as a float. Example input: a list with one trip from north to south by a senior. Example output: two and a half.

title: Gymnastics Routine Score
spec: Write a function `score(routine)` that evaluates a gymnastics performance. The input is a list of tuples containing the skill name and execution deductions. Maintain data for four skills. A backflip has a base difficulty of three and two tenths, and requires acrobatic category. A cartwheel has a base difficulty of one and one tenth, and requires acrobatic category. A pirouette has a base difficulty of two and five tenths, and requires dance category. A handstand has a base difficulty of one and eight tenths, and requires strength category. For each skill, the score is its base difficulty minus the execution deductions. If the deduction is greater than the difficulty, the skill scores zero. Sum the scores of all skills. Then, if the routine includes at least one skill from all three categories, add a bonus of five tenths. Return the final total. Example input: a backflip with zero deductions. Example output: three and two tenths.

title: Airport Gate Assignment
spec: Write a function `assign(flights)` that allocates airport gates to arriving airplanes. The input is a list of tuples containing airline name, aircraft size, and arrival hour. Maintain data for four gates. Gate alpha accepts small and medium aircraft. Gate bravo accepts medium and large aircraft. Gate charlie accepts only large aircraft. Gate delta accepts any size. An assignment is valid if the gate accepts the aircraft size. Iterate through the flights. For each flight, assign the first valid gate from the list alpha, bravo, charlie, delta that is not already occupied in that same arrival hour. If a flight cannot be assigned, ignore it. Return a list of tuples containing the airline name, arrival hour, and the assigned gate name. Example input: a large aircraft arriving at hour ten. Example output: a list with one tuple containing the airline, hour ten, and gate bravo.

title: Zoo Enclosure Diet
spec: Write a function `feed(animals)` that aggregates the daily food requirements for a zoo. The input is a list of animal species names. Maintain data for four species. A lion requires ten kilograms of meat and zero kilograms of vegetation. A zebra requires zero kilograms of meat and twelve kilograms of vegetation. A bear requires five kilograms of meat and five kilograms of vegetation. A monkey requires one kilogram of meat and three kilograms of vegetation. Iterate through the input list, accumulating the total meat and total vegetation required. In addition, apply a bulk discount rule. Every multiple of twenty kilograms of meat requires only eighteen kilograms of actual purchasing, and every multiple of thirty kilograms of vegetation requires only twenty five kilograms. Calculate the final purchased amounts. Return a tuple of total purchased meat and vegetation. Example input: two lions. Example output: a tuple containing eighteen and zero.

title: Theme Park Wait Times
spec: Write a function `estimate(visitors)` that calculates the waiting times for theme park rides based on visitor counts. The input is a tuple of four integers representing the number of visitors at a roller coaster, a water ride, a drop tower, and a haunted house. Maintain data for the capacity and cycle time of each ride. The roller coaster takes twenty four people per cycle and takes three minutes. The water ride takes sixteen people per cycle and takes five minutes. The drop tower takes twelve people per cycle and takes two minutes. The haunted house takes eight people per cycle and takes four minutes. For each ride, divide the visitors by the capacity, round up to the nearest whole number of cycles, and multiply by the cycle time to get the total wait in minutes. Return a tuple of the four wait times. Example input: twenty five visitors at the roller coaster and zero for the rest. Example output: a tuple with six, zero, zero, zero.

title: Job Interview Screener
spec: Write a function `screen(candidates)` that filters job applicants based on their skills. The input is a list of tuples containing candidate name, years of experience, and a list of known programming languages. Maintain data for four roles. A frontend role requires html, css, and javascript, plus two years of experience. A backend role requires python, sql, and linux, plus three years of experience. A mobile role requires swift, kotlin, and java, plus one year of experience. A data role requires python, r, and sql, plus four years of experience. For each candidate, determine which roles they fully qualify for based on both languages and experience. Return a list of tuples, where each tuple contains the candidate name and a list of roles they qualify for. Example input: a candidate with three years experience knowing python, sql, and linux. Example output: a list with one tuple containing the candidate name and a list with the backend role.

title: Hotel Room Booking
spec: Write a function `reserve(requests)` that determines if hotel bookings can be fulfilled. The hotel has three room types. Single rooms have ten units available. Double rooms have five units available. Suite rooms have two units available. Maintain pricing data. Single rooms cost one hundred dollars. Double rooms cost one hundred fifty dollars. Suites cost three hundred dollars. The input is a list of tuples containing guest name, room type requested, and number of nights. Process requests in order. If the requested room type has available units, decrease its availability by one and calculate the total cost by multiplying the price by the number of nights. If no units are available, skip the request. Return a list of tuples containing the guest name, room type, and total cost for fulfilled requests.
